fields.content: Summer, years before. The creek runs low and clear over the crossing stones.
MARCUS, nine, barefoot and sunburnt, is building a dam across the shallows one stone at a time. The water rises behind it, patient.
He sits back on his heels and watches it hold. Then he pulls out the middle stone, and lets it all go.
